book_title: The Philosopher Jawaharlal Nehru: Biography of India's First Prime Minister | Indian Politics, History & Freedom Struggle Book | English Edition
author: Laxman Rao
book_description:
Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru -- Philosopher, Peacemaker, and Nation BuilderDo you just want to read history -- or truly feel and understand it?This book presents Nehru not merely as a political leader, but as a deep thinker, visionary, and humanist. His ideas, values, and policies remain relevant even today.
This book is ideal 
 Politicians and youth aspiring to enter in politics UPSC and Civil Services aspirants preparing for history, polity, or essay papers Teachers and history enthusiasts Students and researchers Any reader seeking to understand India through the eyes of its architect
Inside, you'll 
Explore Nehru's philosophy, ideology, and vision for modern India--shaped by democracy, secularism, socialism, and nonalignment.Read the historic Tryst with Destiny speech and discover Nehru's legacy through his letters, writings, and famous speeches.Gain insights into the transformations in the Indian National Congress under his leadership.Understand India's foreign policy, the Panchsheel principles, and Nehru's handling of India-China relations and global diplomacy.See how Nehru, alongside Mahatma Gandhi, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, Subhash Chandra Bose, Bhagat Singh, and Indira Gandhi, shaped the independence movement and Indian democracy.Trace Nehru's evolution from a nonviolent leader to the architect of modern India, and the nation's emotional response to his passing.If you wish to understand India's foundations -- its thoughts, values, and direction --this book is for you. Order now and discover the visionary who laid the groundwork for modern India.Show more
